name: Robo Island
description: Ultra-sleek AMOLED Black Dynamic Island for Windows featuring an interactive Robot Companion with organic eye physics & desktop mouse glance tracking. Includes Universal Media Player with live scrubbing, RAM & NVMe SSD Storage Health, Background Task Killer, Quick Utilities, and intelligent desktop-safe Auto-Hide (hides while browsing or watching YouTube videos, never on the Home Screen). Built for ultra-low battery consumption (2-5% per day).
author: muthumanikandanb2005-ux
